description: This script attempts to determine the source date epoch for a project or source directory. It checks for the presence of a version file, git or hg repository data, or file modification time as fallback methods, and outputs the found epoch value.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a version.date file and reads the epoch from it.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Uses git to find the latest commit time as the source date epoch.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Uses Mercurial to find the latest commit date as the source date epoch.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Falling back to filesystem modification time using perl.
